title: Power Platform admin center: unified System Administrator user and role management for finance and operations apps
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned general availability release from the documented preview, including role synchronisation and the risk of losing finance and operations-only admin assignments. The controls and licensing statements are supported; the team role path needs only the omitted three-dot menu step.
